beats.say: Answer ten questions about your business, and walk out with your own AI assistant.
head: 10 QUESTIONS.
*YOUR OWN AI.*

beats.say: A lead texts at eleven pm. It reads your prices and drafts the reply. Your price, your open slots, your name.
head: IT REPLIES
*WITH YOUR PRICES.*

scene.q: Hey how much for a full detail on an SUV? Free Saturday?
scene.a: Hi! A full SUV detail is $250 and takes about 3 hours. We come to you. I have Saturday at 9 AM or 1 PM. Want me to lock one in? Mike, Northside Detail

beats.say: They say yes. It writes the quote. Total, what's included, your deposit rule.
head: IT WRITES
*THE QUOTE.*

scene.title: QUOTE · DAVE R.
scene.foot: $50 deposit holds Saturday 9 AM · 24 hr notice to cancel

beats.say: The quote goes quiet for three days. It drafts the follow up before you remember to.
head: IT CHASES
*THE QUIET ONES.*

scene.a: Hi Dave, Mike from Northside. Just checking in on the SUV quote. Saturday 9 AM is still open and the $520 holds through the end of the month. Want me to lock it in?
scene.pill: DRAFT · NOT SENT · tap to approve

beats.say: Job done? It asks for the review, with your link, in your voice.
head: IT ASKS FOR
*THE REVIEW.*

scene.a: Thanks for having us out today, Maria! If you have a minute, a quick Google review would mean a lot: g.page/r/northside. Mike
scene.pill: DRAFT · NOT SENT · tap to approve

beats.say: And the question you answer ten times a day? Answered, before you even see it.
head: THE SAME QUESTION,
*EVERY DAY. HANDLED.*

scene.q: Do you need water or power at my place?
scene.a: Nope, we bring everything, water and power included. You just leave the keys. Want a day this week?

beats.say: Free. No sign up. About five minutes. Build yours, link below.
head: FREE.
*BUILD YOURS.*
